landing.metaTitle: Globetrot · Plan the trip you keep dreaming about
landing.metaDescription: Pin your route on a world map, see what it costs in your currency, and find out when you can afford it. Free to start, in English and Portuguese.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: Plan one trip at a time.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.tagline: For the trip you are saving for.

voyager.name: Voyager
voyager.tagline: For people always planning the next one.

landing.mapAttribution: Map data: Natural Earth · Map lines are illustrative.
landing.trip1Body: Trains only. Port cellars, tiled stairways, a beach day at the end.
landing.trip2Body: A first time abroad, planned around food and very old wood.
landing.trip3Body: Buenos Aires, a ferry, Colonia and Montevideo. Eight days, one border.
landing.heroTitle: Plan the trip on a map. <accent>Know when you can go.</accent>
landing.heroLead: Pin the places, see the route, add what it costs. Globetrot answers the real question — can you afford it, and when — in any currency.
landing.heroNote: Free to start. No card. Estimates, never live quotes.
landing.sampleLine: Japan in April, saving $900 a month
landing.sampleSub: An example answer — yours comes from your own plan.
landing.howTitle: Three steps from a dream to a date.
landing.step1Body: Search a city, drop a pin, drag the route. Nights per stop turn into days.
landing.step2Body: Flights, stays, food — each marked paid, confirmed, an estimate or unknown, in the currency you paid.
landing.step3Body: Tell us what you have and what you can save each month. We tell you the month you can go.
landing.pipBody: Pip is a little traveling globe — and you pick its outfit, hat and bag. It proposes changes as a list you review; nothing happens until you approve, and everything can be undone. Pip is optional: every feature works without it.
landing.pipWhy1: Your Kyoto days are full (10 h).
landing.pipChange2: Move Fushimi Inari to the morning
landing.pipChange3: Mark the ryokan as an estimate
landing.pipWhy3: No booking yet — keep it honest.
landing.pipDemoNote: A demo: these suggestions are examples on this page.
landing.examplesTitle: Copy a trip, then make it yours.
landing.pricingTitle: Start free. Upgrade when the trip gets real.
landing.faq1Q: Does Globetrot hold or move my money?
landing.faq1A: No. Savings are a record you keep. Globetrot never holds funds and never charges for a trip.
landing.faq2A: No. Costs are what you type, and estimates are marked ≈ and labelled as typical ranges, never live quotes.
landing.faq3Q: Is the passport an official document?
landing.faq3A: No. Globetrot visas and stamps are keepsakes for your trips. Always check entry rules on official sites.
landing.faq4Q: Do I have to use Pip or AI?
landing.faq4A: No. Pip is optional. Every feature works by hand, and Pip only proposes changes you approve.
landing.footTagline: Plan the trip on a map. Know when you can go.
